Megan Stirk,   CEO 
People Incorporated 
Megan Stirk began her career in public accounting, 
supervising dozens of audits, with clients around 
the United States in the fields of public housing, 
commercial real estate, residential land development, 
and manufacturing, along with several nonprofit 
organizations. In 2008, Megan joined People 
Incorporated, a nonprofit human services agency based 
in Fall River, Massachusetts, that supports individuals 
with intellectual and developmental disabilities, with 
approximately 30 comprehensive programs that also 
assist children, families, and the SouthCoast community. 
Megan’s initial role at People Incorporated as an 
accounting manager involved fiscal oversight, including 
reporting, audits, and budgets. Her subsequent roles at 
People Incorporated reflected her commitment to the 
Agency and its financial stability, as she was promoted 
to Vice President of Finance in 2012, followed by a dual 
role of Chief Financial Officer / Chief Operating Officer 
in 2016, and finally President & CEO in 2018. Megan 
keeps People Incorporated’s mission, integrity in the 
community, financial stability, and vision for the future as 
her priorities at the helm of the Agency, and she works 
closely with People Incorporated’s 24-hour staff and 
the individuals they support in day programs and 33 
residential homes. 
Megan received her bachelor’s degree in accounting 
and her MBA from the University of Massachusetts 
Dartmouth. Megan is also an active board member 
serving on the MA Association for Early Education and 
Care (MADCA) and a Corporator of BayCoast Bank. She is 
an avid runner, having completed several marathons and 
ultramarathons.
